title: poincare-orchestra: scenario-first LLM orchestration with geometry-aware memory
description: Official open-source reference implementation of the controller, ensemble and synthesis components of 'LLM Orchestration with Geometry-Aware Memory' (IEEE ICBDML 2026, doi:10.1109/ICBDML68582.2026.11544690). Written after the paper; the original experimental system is not released.
